prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one complete full-bleed portrait 2:3 tarot illustration, King of Cups. The first 1 reference image(s) are exact Dragon Quest character identity/costume references; the LAST is ONLY the approved deck ink/color/texture style, not a scene or person to copy.
Scene and exact characters: Actual ADULT DQV Hero in purple turban/cape, white sleeveless robe, green pouch and metal arm bands. He sits steadily on a low stone throne beside a calm sea, holding exactly ONE golden chalice in a relaxed hand, composed kind expression, emotional maturity. One cup total; omit his staff and any secondary cups. A small boat far in the distance, blue water and warm sky, generous quiet dignity. No crown changing his turban, no generic king costume, no child versions or duplicate reference figures.
Shared deck art direction: faithfully drawn Akira Toriyama Dragon Quest characters, clean confident black ink outlines, expressive recognizable faces, crisp hand-painted cel color blocks, restrained shadows and a subtle watercolor-paper grain matching the approved illustration. Original illustration, NOT a 3D screenshot, product photograph, plush, collage or card mockup. Full-bleed single cohesive artwork edge to edge, mobile-readable clear silhouettes and large key symbols.
Hard constraints: no title, no typography, no letters or numerals, no UI, no watermark/logo, no borders or card frame. Any writing, decorative labels, copyright line, duplicate background portraits or layout boxes on reference sheets must NOT appear. Preserve actual named DQ characters, hairstyle/clothing/colors, not generic original substitutes. Keep the stated number of tarot objects exact; avoid incidental extra cups/swords/coins/wands. Do not mix in characters from other franchises.
visual_review: DQV adult Hero purple turban/cape, white robe and green pouch preserved. Exactly one cup on seaside throne, no staff or additional cup, no text/frame.
